verdict.rationale: Bun's docs state that v1.2 made the text-based `bun.lock` the default lockfile (bun-docs-23, bun-docs-38), and the homepage advertises "a lockfile you can read" (bun-docs-31), so an agent can read the lockfile as plain text and diff it. Bun also has a dedicated lockfile docs page covering generation (`--lockfile-only`) and frozen installs (bun-docs-60, bun-docs-35). Missing for 10: a documented specification or schema of the `bun.lock` format, explicit documentation of diffing or reviewing lockfile changes, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the text lockfile reads and diffs cleanly.
